 Looking for a countdown timer

 Thread starter 

 AsherN 

 Start date 

 Sep 29, 2021 

 A 

 AsherN 

 New Member

 We are a place of worship. Using OBS to Streamspot. Streamspot starts the stream on a schedule. Their implementation involves a Scheduled Task on Windows that fires every minute to see if it should be streaming, and if so starts OBS. We run 2 regular services a week, Friday evening at 1830 and Saturday morning at 1030. 

Right now, we set Streamspot to start 12 minutes before. Upon starting we display a simple "Our services will start soon" slide. Then, using the Advanced scene switcher plug in, I use the "Time" tab to switch to a timer slide at 1820 or 1030 and the 'Sequence" tab to switch from the timer slide to a live camera after 10 minutes. 

That works well. However, we often also have different events/services on other days and/or times. 

What I'm trying to achieve is a timer that will calculate the amount of time from the display of the slide to the top or bottom of the hour. And then to switch to a different scene when that timer reaches 0. 

Does such a thing exists?

 Banyarola 

 Active Member

 I have all that. What I'm looking for is a timer that will calculate how long to either the top or bottom of the hour depending on when it starts. i.e. if the scene pops up at 10:18 it will count down 12 minutes to 10:30. If it pops up at 10:31, it will count down 29 minutes to 11:00. And then when the timer reaches 0 (or when the text changes) it switches scenes.
